flags.detail: PO-1130 line 1: billed 120, open to bill 100

outcome.explanation:
Invoice DAI-6120 from Dairy Supplier bills 120 gallons of whole milk at $4.20 each, $504.00 in total. Only 100 gallons have been received against PO-1130 (on 2026-11-06), so it bills 20 gallons ($84.00) more than we got. The price and the bank account (ending 2002) both match what's on file.

Hold the invoice. Only $420.00, the cost of the 100 gallons received, is supported right now, and the rest should wait until the other 20 gallons arrive or the vendor sends a corrected invoice or credit note for $84.00. I saved a draft email asking the vendor for one of these, and it hasn't been sent, so please review it before you send it.

email_draft.subject: Invoice DAI-6120 / PO-1130 – quantity billed exceeds quantity received
email_draft.body:
Hello,

We received your invoice DAI-6120 dated 2026-11-11 for 120 gallons of whole milk at $4.20 (total $504.00) against PO-1130.

Our records show only 100 gallons were received (delivery on 2026-11-06). The remaining 20 gallons ($84.00) have not been received.

Could you please either confirm when the remaining 20 gallons will be delivered, or send a corrected invoice or credit note for $84.00 so the invoice matches the 100 gallons received ($420.00)?

Thank you,
Accounts Payable
